objective: Adjudicate the unresolved same-bar vs spec-literal next-open rebound-confirmation fork against the spec, reconcile the contradictory native runs (C14 canonical +8,914.33 / 7 trades vs C18 spec-literal -47,933.58 / 22 trades on the same archive), and issue a single decision-grade Hyperliquid-native final verdict that supersedes the fragmented C1-C18 record.
why_this_is_the_binding_task: Native-market acquisition is exhausted (C15/C16/C17/C18 all BLOCKED_EVIDENCED_DATA_REQUIRED: public Hyperliquid candleSnapshot is a moving tail, earliest ~2026-04-21; the only HF native archive starts 2025-05-25). The one remaining executable, non-blocked, decision-relevant question is whether the canonical same-bar confirmation gate is spec-faithful. That single choice flips the native sign (+8.9k underpowered vs -47.9k NO_GO), so it must be adjudicated before any final verdict.

adjudication_question.statement: Does the spec require a same-bar rebound-confirmation candle (canonical confirm_rebound on the signal bar) before the next-open buy, or is the spec-literal reading (RSI(21)<20 close -> buy at next hourly open, no same-bar confirmation) the faithful one?
candidate_readings: SPEC_LITERAL_NEXT_OPEN: no same-bar rebound confirmation; produces C18 (77 signals, 22 trades, -47,933.58).
CANONICAL_SAME_BAR_RETAINED: same-bar confirm_rebound required; produces C14 (9 signals, 7 trades, +8,914.33).
adjudication_question.decision_rule_pre_registered: The reading with direct spec-text support wins. If SPEC_LITERAL_NEXT_OPEN wins, the native verdict is NO_GO (22 trades, -47,933.58) and the C14 same-bar result must be demoted to a non-spec sensitivity. If CANONICAL_SAME_BAR_RETAINED wins, the native verdict remains UNDERPOWERED (C14) and C18 is a non-spec sensitivity. Either way a single consolidated final verdict must be produced; no post-hoc switching.

hypothesis.description: After adjudicating Q1 and re-running the native battery under the winning reading, the evidence yields exactly one honest final verdict token.
hypothesis.selection_rule: Fixed by this prereg; no config switching after results.
